description: This file implements the DataReaderFactory class, which creates instances of DataReaderV1 or DataReaderV2 based on the version information read from a data buffer. It includes functions for reading little-endian uint32 values and manages external dependencies related to data reading and shared memory utilities.

classes.name: DataReaderFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating appropriate DataReader instances based on the version information in the data buffer.

methods.name: createDataReader
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IDataReader implementation (DataReaderV1 or DataReaderV2) based on the version read from the data buffer.
